# passwordsafe_managed_account (Data Source)

Managed Account Datasource, gets managed account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "passwordsafe_managed_account" "manage_account_01" {
  system_name  = "system01"
  account_name = "managed_account02"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_name` (String) Managed account name.
- `system_name` (String) System account name. It can contain "/" characters.

### Optional

- `value` (String, Sensitive) Managed account credential.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
